message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” here means a three‑day stretch that includes a statutory holiday on a Friday or a Monday, or a holiday observed on a Monday when the actual holiday falls on a weekend.)

| Long‑Weekend Dates | Holiday (Observed) | Notes |
|--------------------|--------------------|-------|
| **Jan 1–3** | New Year’s Day (observed Jan 2) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday; the holiday was observed on Monday, giving a 2‑day weekend (Sunday + Monday). |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Ontario) | Family Day in Ontario is the 3rd Monday in February. |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday | Good Friday is always on Friday, so the weekend is extended. |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day | Victoria Day is the Monday preceding May 25. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (observed Jul 3) | Canada Day fell on Saturday; the holiday was observed on Monday, giving a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day | Labour Day is the 1st Monday in September. |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving is the 2nd Monday in October. |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day (observed Nov 13) | Remembrance Day fell on Saturday; the holiday was observed on Monday. |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas Day | Christmas Day is on Monday, giving a 3‑day weekend. |

### Quick‑look by month

| Month | Long‑Weekend Dates | Holiday |
|-------|--------------------|---------|
| January | Jan 1–3 | New Year’s Day |
| February | Feb 18–20 | Family Day (Ontario) |
| April | Apr 7–9 | Good Friday |
| May | May 20–22 | Victoria Day |
| July | Jul 1–3 | Canada Day |
| September | Sep 2–4 | Labour Day |
| October | Oct 7–9 | Thanksgiving |
| November | Nov 11–13 | Remembrance Day |
| December | Dec 23–25 | Christmas Day |

> **Pro‑Tip:** Some provinces have additional holidays that create long weekends (e.g., Family Day in British Columbia on the 1st Monday in February, St. Patrick’s Day in certain provinces, etc.). If you need province‑specific long weekends, let me know and I can add those too.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app or use it as a reference for scheduling your long‑weekend getaways!
